liveSchemaBaselineNote: Measured against LIVE schema discovered this run (problems, problem_assets, writing_drafts, writing_submissions, writing_feedback, feedback_dimension_scores, sentence_feedback, study_events, plus recommendation/library/export tables). No assumed columns used. D-04 shares the unified writing contract with D-01/D-03 (questions 51/53).

seedProvenance.shape: ARRAY length 154, each item HOMOGENEOUS keys (verified first/mid/last)
seedProvenance.stableId: item.id (string e.g. 'topik54-154-b01-01') — used as deterministic seed provenance; NEVER array index. All 154 ids unique.
seedProvenance.metaShape: meta = {domain (TOPIC domain e.g. '기술'/'사회'/'경제' — NOT the schema skill-domain), topic_type, question_type, difficulty (int), inference_gap (bool)}

seedProvenance.notes: Unlike D-03, D-04 items carry NO chart/graph/table structure (essay topic only): no chart_a/chart_b/context_notes/relation. review_passed is false on all 154 items in this sample.

jsonMapping.meaning: Stable per-item string id (e.g. 'topik54-154-b01-01'); used as the deterministic seed id for the 54 problem (NOT array index). Source file + this id preserved as provenance. All 154 ids unique.
Full essay task instruction shown to learner ('다음을 주제로 하여 자신의 생각을 600~700자로 쓰시오 ... (50점)' + 3 sub-tasks). Maps by meaning + name.
Human-readable topic title (e.g. '디지털 시민성'); problems.title is NOT NULL so derived directly from topic_seed_title.
Scoring rubric object — homogeneous {content, structure, language} for the essay item. Maps by meaning + name.
Reference model essay used as answer key / grading reference. Maps by MEANING (answer reference), not by key name.
Question-shaping metadata (essay type, topic type, inference-gap flag). No typed columns exist for these; stored in the materials blob (jsonb-covered).

Seed meta.domain is a TOPIC domain ('기술'/'사회'/'경제'); the schema domain is the TOPIK SKILL domain and must be clamped to 'writing' for question 54 (deterministic derive, NOT from the JSON value). meta.domain itself rides materials jsonb.
Difficulty integer (5 in samples); maps to problems.difficulty, clamp to CHECK 1..5.

Review gate; review_passed=true derives review_status='approved'. Deterministic derive, NOT a direct column copy. (All 154 sample items have review_passed=false -> 'pending'.) review_memo is editorial provenance only (rides materials/explanation jsonb if kept; NOT user-facing).
Authoring timestamp; may seed problems.created_at or be ignored in favor of default now(). Deterministic if copied. Provenance only.
Provenance-fixed constants for the D-04 / question 54 seed (54 is TOPIK II writing, 50점 essay). Not read from JSON.

frozenIslandNote: No admin codes (H-01/X-08/X-10/X-15, folders 21/30/32/37) and no frozen objects (organizations, org_members, assignments, assignment_submissions, admin_*/get_admin_*) touched. All rows resolve to user-facing problems/problem_assets/writing_drafts/writing_submissions/study_events tables + the public.submit_writing_with_feedback RPC.
idempotencyNote: Any seed would be an ADDITIVE upsert on problems.id derived from sample-54.json item.id (deterministic string id), with domain clamped to 'writing', question_no=54, topik_level=2, difficulty clamped 1..5, review_status derived from review_passed — an unchanged-source re-run is a byte-identical no-op. No drop/reset/truncate. NOTE: NO migration is applied here — this is the conformance matrix only (READ-ONLY run).
overallVerdict: All confirmed screen data requirements are SATISFIED or JSONB-COVERED by the LIVE schema. The single documented '스키마 보강 필요' item (typed 논제/관점/금지조건/모범구성안 validation) stays jsonb-covered per CONTRACT-NOT-LABEL since the 메모 accepts rubric/materials JSON and description.md states no concrete typed-column query/validation/render need (panel displays; checklist is client-derived). No schema-gap, no unresolved escalation. D-04 reuses the unified writing contract already proven for D-01/D-03.
